description: Defines the configurable questions, response types, validation rules, evidence requirements, and blocking behavior used by the Data4Mat Takeover Audit module.

questions.text: What is the client's legal name?
questions.helpText: Use the registered legal name of the client organization.

questions.text: Who is the primary client contact?
questions.helpText: Record the main person responsible for communication and approvals.

questions.text: Which websites, domains, or digital services are included in the engagement?
questions.helpText: Record every website, domain, application, or related service included in the takeover audit.

collection.emptyMessage: No systems have been added to the engagement scope.

questions.text: What is the agreed engagement start date?
What type of engagement has been agreed?
What is the current commercial status of the engagement?
Is access review included in the agreed scope?
Is backup verification included in the agreed scope?
Is DNS inventory and control verification included in the agreed scope?
Is hosting review included in the agreed scope?
Is application review included in the agreed scope?
Is security review included in the agreed scope?
Is performance review included in the agreed scope?
Is compliance review included in the agreed scope?
Is remediation planning included in the agreed scope?
Record all items explicitly excluded from the agreed scope.

collection.emptyMessage: No scope exclusions have been recorded.

questions.text: Record commercial risks, dependencies, or assumptions that may affect the engagement.

collection.emptyMessage: No commercial risks or dependencies have been recorded.

questions.text: Record all systems and services for which access is required.
questions.helpText: Include registrars, DNS providers, hosting systems, applications, email platforms, analytics services, payment services, and other relevant systems.

collection.emptyMessage: No required systems have been recorded.

questions.text: Were credentials transferred without using plain email?
questions.helpText: Credentials must be transferred through an approved secure method.

questions.text: Has a unique account been created for Data4Mat where separate access is supported?
Is MFA enabled for all identified admin-level accounts?
Have all shared administrative accounts been identified?
Have all unknown or unexplained administrative users been identified?
Record known user accounts and their assigned roles.

collection.emptyMessage: No user accounts have been recorded.

questions.text: Record missing access and other access-related blockers.

collection.emptyMessage: No access blockers have been recorded.

questions.text: Is all critical access documented and confirmed sufficiently to continue the takeover audit?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation if any critical access remains unclear.

blockingRules.message: Critical access is not sufficiently documented and confirmed. Dependent takeover work cannot continue.

questions.text: Record all backup systems and backup methods currently used for the systems in scope.
questions.helpText: Include hosting backups, application backups, database backups, file backups, external storage, and third-party backup services.

collection.emptyMessage: No backup systems have been recorded.

questions.text: Does the available backup include all files required to restore the systems in scope?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the backup contents, manifest, archive listing, or other evidence showing what is included.

questions.text: Does the available backup include all databases required to restore the systems in scope?
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the database export, backup archive, provider confirmation, or other evidence.

questions.text: Are backups stored separately from the production environment?
questions.helpText: A failure or compromise of the production environment should not automatically destroy every usable backup.

questions.text: Are backup operations automated where automation is available?
Are backup failures monitored and reported to a responsible person?
Is access to backup storage restricted to authorized users?
Are sensitive backups encrypted where encryption is required or reasonably available?
What is the declared restore verification status?
questions.helpText: A backup existing is not the same as confirming that it can be restored.

choices.label: Archive inspected but restore not tested

questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the restore test record, test environment, logs, screenshots, or inspection evidence.

questions.text: When was the most recent restore test performed?
Record the restore test result and any limitations discovered.
Has Data4Mat created or secured a current pre-intervention backup before any production changes are made?

choices.label: Not applicable because no intervention is authorized

questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the backup created or secured for the takeover and its storage location.

questions.text: Record backup-related deficiencies, unresolved risks, or required actions.

collection.emptyMessage: No backup issues have been recorded.

questions.text: Is a sufficiently current and usable backup verified so the takeover audit can continue?
questions.helpText: Select No or Requires confirmation when the backup is missing, failed, incomplete, inaccessible, or insufficiently verified.
questions.evidenceGuidance: Reference the verified backup and the evidence supporting the declared restore status.

blockingRules.message: A sufficiently current and usable backup has not been verified. Dependent takeover work cannot continue.
